section.content: 本实用新型属于电池技术领域，尤其涉及一种锂离子电池，包括电池本体和底片，底片贴设于电池本体的底部，其特征在于：底片外表面上靠近其长度方向两端的位置分别设有第一图案标识和第二图案标识，第一图案标识和第二图案标识的形状和大小均相同，且第一图案标识相对于第二图案标识呈180°倒置设置，这样操作人员在将底片贴合到电池本体上时，从而就可以无需特地辨识底片上含有图案标识的方向，随机拿起底片便可以进行粘贴，节约了贴底片时花费分辨方向的时间；以及可以避免因操作人员精力不集中而导致底片方向贴错的情况发生，起到了“防呆”的作用，有效提升了产品的良品率，减少安全隐患，具有极佳的市场应用前景。

The utility model belongs to battery technology field, more particularly to a kind of lithium ion battery, including battery body and egative film, Negative plate paster is set to the bottom of battery body, it is characterized by: the position on egative film outer surface close to its length direction both ends is respectively equipped with the first pattern identification and the second pattern identification, the shapes and sizes of first pattern identification and the second pattern identification are all the same, and first pattern identification be arranged relative to the second pattern identification in 180 ° of inversion, operator is when fitting to egative film on battery body in this way, to can not need to specially recognize the direction on egative film containing pattern identification, picking up egative film at random can be pasted, the time for differentiating direction is spent when having saved patch egative film；And can occur to avoid the situation for causing egative film direction patch wrong because operator's energy is not concentrated, play the role of " fool proof ", effectively improve the yields of product, reduce security risk, there is splendid market application prospect.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical field

The utility model belongs to battery technology field more particularly to a kind of lithium ion battery.

Background technique

Currently, with the continuous improvement of people's material and cultural life and the fast development of electronics market, such as The raising and plant produced of the various digital electronic goods performances such as smart phone, digital camera, electronics bracelet, DV, older mobile phone The increase of line manufacturing cost and the raising of fraction defective.

In battery industry, lithium ion battery of mobile phone is very universal in the market.In existing lithium ion battery of mobile phone system In making, battery is completed by battery core, protection board, upper and lower covers rubber shell, labeling this several big main part.Some egative films have special word When female mark will, patch egative film is typically all that assigned direction is needed to go to paste.Which adds the costs in manpower working hour and production.Manpower Operation is differentiated, will not inevitably be malfunctioned.The quality for so being easy for that product is caused egative film letter designations anisotropy occur is bad hidden Suffer from.

Utility model content

The purpose of this utility model is to provide a kind of lithium ion batteries, it is intended to solve in the prior art to need adhesive tape mark When the lithium ion battery of the egative film of knowledge, operator is easy the technical problem that error causes product quality bad.

A kind of in order to achieve the above purposes, the technical solution adopted by the utility model is: lithium ion battery, including battery body And egative film, the Negative plate paster are set to the bottom of the battery body, on the egative film outer surface its close length direction both ends Position is respectively equipped with the first pattern identification and the second pattern identification, the shape of first pattern identification and the second pattern identification and Size is all the same, and first pattern identification is arranged relative to second pattern identification in 180 ° of inversions.

Preferably, first pattern identification to the bottom panel length direction midpoint distance and the second pattern mark The distance known to the midpoint in the bottom panel length direction is identical.

Preferably, first pattern identification passes through laser engraving molding or ink spray mo(u)lding, second pattern Mark passes through laser engraving molding or ink spray mo(u)lding.

Preferably, the egative film is adhered to the bottom of the battery body by glue or double-sided adhesive.

Preferably, the bottom of the battery body offers the attachment region adhered to for the glue or the double-sided adhesive, Length direction of the attachment region along the battery body bottom is arranged.

Preferably, groove corresponding with the attachment region, the inner wall of the groove are offered on the medial surface of the egative film Enclose the accommodating area for setting and being formed and being accommodated for the glue or the double-sided adhesive jointly with the inner wall of the attachment region.

Preferably, the medial surface of the egative film is also provided with two anti-overflow slots for preventing the glue from overflowing, and two The extending direction of the anti-overflow slot is identical as the extending direction of the groove, and two anti-overflow slots are respectively positioned on the groove Two sides.

Preferably, the outer surface of the egative film offers identification slot, and the identification slot is set along the length direction of the egative film It sets, and the identification slot position is between first pattern identification and second pattern identification.

Preferably, there are two the identification slot is set, and two identification slot parallelly distribute ons.

Preferably, the battery body includes battery core, upper cover, protection board, two nickel sheet, bracket and labeling, the bracket It is installed on the top of the battery core, two nickel sheet are respectively arranged in the side on the bracket, the protection board installation In the top on the bracket and positioned at two nickel sheet, the upper cover is covered on the protection board, and the labeling is sticked In on the lateral surface of the battery core, the Negative plate paster is set to the bottom of the battery core

The utility model has the beneficial effects that the lithium ion battery of the utility model, is distinguished by the both sides on egative film First pattern identification and the second pattern identification are set, wherein the shapes and sizes of the first pattern identification and the second pattern identification are equal It is identical, and make the first pattern identification and the second pattern identification in arranging in the opposite direction, such operator is inciting somebody to action When egative film is fitted on battery body, no matter how to be attached to egative film on battery body, can make client on battery body It is required that side contain specific pattern identification, to can not need to specially recognize on egative film containing the first pattern identification Or second pattern identification direction, to pick up egative film at random can be pasted, and spent when having saved patch egative film and differentiated direction Time；And can occur to avoid the situation for causing egative film direction patch wrong because operator's energy is not concentrated, it plays " anti- It is slow-witted " effect, effectively improve the yields of product, reduce security risk, there is splendid market application prospect.
